title: pssc trace show --json
description: The events of a test trace (pssc test --trace writes .pssunit/traces/<test-id>.ndjson, be-bc zbc-trace/2), each with its source line; with --at, one event and the source lines around its location; with --line, the events that ran a line. Fields not listed here may be added; readers ignore them.

seed.description: The seed the traced run used (trace header).

events.description: The events after --kind/--coro/--line; with --at, the one event.

at.description: --at: the event index asked for (for a time: the last event at or before it).

at_time.description: --at TIME (a simulation trace): the time asked for, in fs.

from.description: --at: the event whose location is used (the last located event at or before `at`); null if none.

file.description: --at: the location's file; --line: FILE as given.

context.description: --at: the source lines around `line`; empty when the file is not found.

indexes.description: --line: every event index located at the line (before --kind/--coro).

kind.description: stmt, call, return, check, access, branch, message, chan, import, sanitizer, test.start, test.end, ... or an orchestration kind (SPAWN, WAIT, ...).

file.description: The source path as the model's provenance spells it; null when the event has no location.

detail.description: The kind's payload, as in the trace.

text.description: The source line, stripped; null when the file is not found.

t.description: The sim time of the event in fs; only in a simulation trace (+pssvm_trace).
